description:
Located on 21st Avenue—just half a block from Geary Blvd.—this bright, fully remodeled three bedroom, one and a half bath apartment offers modern finishes, exceptional convenience, and easy access to one of San Francisco’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Enjoy close proximity to shops, cafés, restaurants, entertainment, and public transportation in every direction.
Apartment Features
•	Fully remodeled throughout
•	Beautiful engineered wood floors
•	Porcelain tile in kitchen and bathrooms
•	Remodeled kitchen with all new stainless steel appliances and Quartz Kitchen Counter
o	New electric stove
o	New dishwasher
o	Built in microhood microwave
o	New garbage disposal
•	Open living/dining area with engineered wood floors
•	Three bedrooms
•	One full bathroom + one half bathroom (both remodeled)
•	Linen closet
•	Recessed lighting
•	Parking for one car included
•	Shared backyard
•	Water and garbage included
•	Small dog or cat OK
•	No smoking
Building Details
•	Butique 4 unit apartment building.
•	Apartment #1 — located on the second floor of a three story, four unit building
•	Coin operated laundry on site
Neighborhood
The Inner Richmond blends culture, cuisine, and outdoor recreation. Clement and Geary offer an incredible mix of Chinese, Russian, and Irish eateries—dim sum, borscht, and Guinness all within blocks. Golden Gate Park, Baker Beach, and Ocean Beach are just minutes away.
How to Apply
If interested, please send an email with your name and telephone number so we can contact you to schedule an appointment to view the unit.

3-bedroom, 1.5-bath single-family home in Bernal Heights, approximately 1,600 sq ft. Private backyard, one compact-car parking space in the garage with full garage access, and brand-new washer, dryer and dishwasher.
Main level includes living room, dining room, eat-in kitchen, one bedroom and full bath. Upstairs are two large bedrooms, including one with an en-suite half bath.
Conveniently located near Cortland Avenue's restaurants, shops and bars, as well as the Bernal Heights Library, Community Center and Rec Centers. Close to Bernal Heights Park. Convenient to the 24, 67, 14 and 49 Muni lines, 24th St BART, and 101/280. Managed by owner.
Rent: $7,750/month
Available: August 31
Lease: 12 months
Utilities: Tenant pays all utilities
Parking: 1 compact car in attached garage
Laundry: Private In-Unit
Outdoor space: Private backyard
Pets: Considered
Furnished: No
Photos are from a previous staging. Floors of final bedroom were retouched using AI as floors are currently being repainted. Home will be shown and offered unfurnished.
12-month lease. Tenant responsible for all utilities. Pets considered with owner approval. No smoking. Renters insurance required.
To apply, please email back with information about the members of your household, desired move-in date, and all the 15 minute time slots you are available to tour within the current 2 tour dates: Tuesday 8/18 from 5:15pm to 6:30pm and Thursday 8/20 from 5:15pm to 6:30pm. We will email back with the confirmed time slot.

Family home available for sublet in sunny Bernal Heights while we are travelling. We are seeking subletters who will enjoy our home and take care of it. Perfect for families, individuals, and couples of all ages. Our house is filled with character, with expansive views of downtown and the city, and would be most enjoyed by artistic individuals who appreciate creative architecture. The main floor includes a beautiful kitchen and living room, multiple bedrooms, a bathroom, and office space. The downstairs levels include additional sleeping areas, bathrooms, and a spacious family room. We are located on a flat street with a wide sidewalk, accessible on foot to all amenities. Serious inquiries only.

Rarely available and on the rental market for the first time in 40 years - a fully remodeled top-floor Victorian apartment in the heart of the Mission District. Approximately 1,400 sq ft, blending original 1910 character with a complete 2026 renovation.
THE HOME
- 3 spacious bedrooms
- Full bath plus a separate toilet room
- Two grand formal rooms (living and dining), each with an original Victorian fireplace, bay windows, and built-in china cabinets
- Restored original oak and parquet floors, high ceilings, wainscoting and crown molding
- Remodeled kitchen: quartz-style counters and backsplash, stainless refrigerator, gas range, generous cabinetry
- Updated bath: marble-style tile, glass-enclosed shower, modern black fixtures
- In-unit laundry, central heat and A/C, smart doorbell
- Shared greenhouse bonus space
- Sweeping downtown San Francisco skyline views from the top floor
TERMS
Rent: $7,350/month
Security deposit: $7,350
Lease: 12 months minimum, longer terms available
Available: immediately
Included in rent: water and trash
Tenant pays: PG&E (gas and electric), internet, cable
Parking: street parking only
Smoking: not permitted
Pets: considered, $250 pet deposit
Located steps from the restaurants and shops along 22nd Street, with convenient access to transit.
Full photo gallery and details: missionvictorian.com
Serious inquiries only.

Solid 3 bed 2 bath on Folsom St in Bernal Heights ,  2096 sq ft of real house, available Sep 3 at $5495/month.
This is a full home with a decorative fireplace and period mantle in the living room, a remodeled bath with radiant floor heat, and a kitchen that's been done right ,  gas stove, stainless steel dishwasher, oak countertops, and a cedar-lined pantry. There's also a home office, a rear deck, and a gated backyard. Below is a legal 2-bedroom unit with its own updated kitchen and bath and a private entrance through the rear yard ,  you can use the whole place as a single home or keep the units separate, your call. 1-car garage with an automatic opener, 2 laundry rooms on site. Walk Score of 94, with Bernal Heights Park up the hill and Precita Park a few blocks out, plus restaurants, shops & transit all within easy walking distance. Close to the 101 and 280 if you need to get out of the city.
Water, trash, and sewage are covered. Tenant pays gas and electric (PG&E) and handles yard care. 12-month lease, longer preferred. Security deposit is $5495.

2262 Filbert Street, San Francisco, CA 94123
Beautifully remodeled top-floor 5-room Victorian flat in the heart of Cow Hollow, one of San Francisco’s most desirable and walkable neighborhoods. Occupying the top floor of an intimate 3-flat Victorian building, this spacious residence combines classic San Francisco character with extensive modern updates. The top-floor location provides excellent natural light, privacy, and a wonderful residential feel.
Property Highlights:
•	Top-floor 5-room Victorian flat
•	Newly remodeled throughout
•	Beautiful hardwood floors
•	High ceilings and abundant natural light
•	Classic Victorian architectural details
•	Spacious formal living room
•	Separate formal dining room
•	Flexible rooms for bedrooms, home office, or guest room
•	Remodeled bathroom
•	Updated kitchen with new appliances
•	In-unit washer and dryer
•	Recessed lighting and modern finishes
•	Excellent Cow Hollow location
•	Near Union Street, Chestnut Street, Marina District, restaurants, cafés, shopping, parks, and public transportation
